gizmo.title: Jerin matakai
gizmo.description: Matakai masu lamba don kammala aiki.

configure.title: Mai nuna matakai
configure.description: Nuna matakan a matsayin ƙaramin layin take da ke alamta ci gaba. Ba a nuna abun cikin matakai a wannan tsari ba.

configure.title: Mataki na yanzu
configure.description: Matakin da mai karatu yake a kai, ana ƙirga daga 1. Matakan da suka gabata suna bayyana a matsayin an kammala. Mai nuna matakai ke amfani da shi.
